name: Nandagiri Foods Catering AND Events
address: Ms menon lane, Nellikunnu, Thrissur, Keralam 680005

reviews.name: udhayan unnikrishnan
reviews.quote: I recently had the pleasure of enjoying a traditional vegetarian Sadhya, and it was nothing short of extraordinary. The variety of dishes – each carefully prepared and thoughtfully served – captured the essence of Kerala’s rich culinary heritage.

reviews.name: Geetha Menon
reviews.quote: Attended a sadya just now. Every curry & payasam was superb. Staff were also repeatedly offering food.

reviews.name: Kesavadas K
reviews.quote: A Taste to Remember! Every dish was a burst of flavor and elegance. The team’s warmth, care, and flawless service made our event feel truly special. An unforgettable culinary experience..highly recommended!

reviews.name: Retheesh Ammayath
reviews.quote: Very nice & delicious.. They are professionals. They takes marriage and other functions orders.

reviews.name: Ranjith Rajeevan
reviews.quote: One of the best catering available at Thrissur..
